frozenFor: docs/DECISIONS.md D-074 (GENESIS-MOL-01) — D-069 Option A hard filters, liability source
fingerprintMethod: provenance.mjs::canonicalHash(terms).slice(0,16) — derived from the `terms` array below ONLY, so editing any threshold changes this value
source: campaign/molecularLiabilities.mjs (RDKit-native deterministic rules); NOT ADMET-AI, NOT a fitted model

rationale.structuralAlertCount: PAINS (Baell & Holloway, J Med Chem 2010), BRENK (Brenk et al., ChemMedChem 2008) and NIH/MLSMR screening-deck alerts, via RDKit FilterCatalog. Standard practice excludes alert-matching compounds from a lead series; the cut-off of 0 is the rule sets' own binary semantics, not a tuned number.
rationale.lipinskiViolations: Lipinski et al., Adv Drug Deliv Rev 1997. The published rule itself permits at most one violation — the threshold IS the rule, not a choice of ours.
rationale.veberPass: Veber et al., J Med Chem 2002 (rotatable bonds <= 10 AND TPSA <= 140 A^2) for oral bioavailability. Binary pass/fail as published.

deliberatelyNotGated.qed: QED (Bickerton et al., Nat Chem 2012) is a continuous desirability score with no canonical cut-off. Choosing one would be an arbitrary success threshold, which D-074's own mission brief forbids. QED is COMPUTED AND REPORTED for every candidate as an uncertainty/confidence signal, and gates nothing.
